info.title: Amnezia Config API
info.description: Offline explicit operation contract. Runtime OpenAPI publication remains disabled; generic HTTP mutation route is expanded here. Responses and command schema differ from WireGuard; create returns 200. Responses include X-Request-ID (req_ plus 26 uppercase ULID characters). Platform ignores caller-selected IDs; VPN facades accept a single valid ID only after server authentication. Optional correlation metadata, never a credential or idempotency key. JSON DTO and command schemas unchanged.

get.description: Atomic verified client state and configuration after one serialized reconcile. Contains secrets; private no-store. Requires configured server identity; old routes remain available.
Optional raw counters. No reconcile, configuration export or access mutation. Unsupported is 422, unavailable is 503; never substitute zero. Private no-store.
Contains client secrets; private no-store. Never include real content in fixtures.

CreateClient.title: Command
CreateClient.description: Agent enforces operation rules after reconcile. Expiry must be UTC, <=2100, future for new operations; renewal must not shorten access. Reuse the same idempotency key after a lost response; replace allow_create=false only observes a previously started operation.
